title.zh: Mino Bridge — 远程访问与安全守护

description.en: Scan the QR code to keep using Mino on mobile or public networks when you're away from your computer. One-tap LAN QR code, Cloudflare public tunnel, self-hosted tunnel, and WeChat / QQ / Lark / Telegram bots (multi-workspace / session persistence / media / card approval / streaming output), no public server required.
description.zh: 手机扫码即可在移动端/公网继续用 Mino，人不在电脑前也能接着干。一键局域网二维码、Cloudflare 公网隧道、自建隧道与微信 / QQ / 飞书 / Telegram Bot（多工作区/会话持久化/媒体/卡片审批/流式输出），无需自己搭公网服务器。
